tips.text: Donner Summit is 7,239 ft westbound and 7,227 ft eastbound. Caltrans runs chain controls on this pass in snow, and the pass can close in the worst storms.

Colfax, Cisco Grove, and Emigrant Gap have DOE listings and no Electrify America site we could confirm. They are listed on the Auburn and Truckee stops with their own town names, and they are not primaries.

A West Sacramento search (6 miles) returned 52 DC fast sites, including Sacramento chargers across the river. That search is not a stop here. San Francisco, Oakland, and the Bay Bridge approach are not listed either. This guide starts at Fairfield.

arrival: Arrival charging around Lake Tahoe, including the CA-267 basin, is not in this guide. The last stop is Truckee on I-80.
